overall: The AG found the School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to state the litigation subject of its February 12 executive session in the notice and before entering session, but noted its self-corrective steps and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the meeting notice did not state the subject of the February 12 litigation executive session with enough detail.
Complaint alleged the chair's verbal statement before entering executive session did not identify the subject of the session.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to notice the subject of its February 12 executive session and by failing to publicly disclose the subject of its discussion prior to entering into executive session during the February 12 meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Committee that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
